original.target_description: Assigned original Study 1: preference for indirect versus direct harm. Full original paper could not be acquired through attempted open routes; no test statistics extracted from replication summaries.

replication.target_description: Second replication: American MTurk sample, morality judgments for organ transplant and zoo scenarios. Page 7 Table 4 supplies separate scenario tests, but the supplied description does not identify either scenario or a between-scenario comparison. Exact target test unknown.

notes: Original full-text acquisition failed through attempted open routes (DOI landing inaccessible; author-hosted PDF 403; CiteSeer PDF 404; alternate PDF host 403). Original locator names Study 1, whereas the replication authors explicitly replicated original Study 2. Replication test is ambiguous: Table 4 reports MTurk organ d = 0.24, t(313) = 4.16, p < .001; MTurk zoo d = 0.36, t(313) = 6.31, p < .001. No scenario was specified, so neither is selected. Abstract d = 0.46 and 0.47 are mini-meta-analysis effects (p.8), not Study 2 effects.
